# **Combining web cache poisoning vulnerabilities**

Task: This lab is susceptible to web cache poisoning, but only if you construct a complex exploit chain.

			A user visits the home page roughly once a minute and their language is set to English. To solve this lab, poison the cache with a response that executes `alert(document.cookie)` in the visitor's browser.

Toolkit: BurpSuite, Browser

1. find unkeyed parameters X-Forwarded-Host & X-Original-Url  
2. reflects in host X-Forwarded-Host

       \<script\>  
            data \= {"host":"asdfgh","path":"/"}  
        \</script\>  
…  
                   \<script\>  
                        initTranslations('//' \+ data.host \+ '/resources/json/translations.json');  
                    \</script\>

X-Original-Url get us 200 or 302 to change start page

3. /resources/json/translations.json

and /resources/js/[translations.js](http://translations.js) which uses innerHTML, also we can get page with tranlantion
